# Google Chrome Browser Interface

## System and Window Header

- **Operating System Taskbar**: Located at the top of the screen, displaying system-level controls and applications.
  - **Left Side**: "Activities" button for switching between workspaces or launching applications.
  - **Center**: Date and time display: "Oct 22 21:30".
  - **Right Side**: System status icons including:
    - Network connectivity indicator.
    - Sound/volume control.
    - Battery status.
    - Power button for shutting down or restarting the system.

## Browser Window

### Browser Tabs

- **Tab Bar**: Located directly below the system header.
  - **Active Tab**: "New Tab" (highlighted with a blue underline).
  - **Inactive Tab**: Another "New Tab" tab to the left of the active one.
  - **Tab Management**: Each tab has a close button (X) on its right side.
  - **New Tab Button**: A "+" icon on the far right of the tab bar for opening a new tab.

### Address Bar

- **Location Bar**: A long, rectangular input field for entering URLs or search queries.
  - **Left Side**: Contains the Google "G" logo.
  - **Right Side**: Includes a star icon for bookmarking the current page.
  - **User Profile Icon**: A small blue person icon for accessing user account settings.
  - **Update Notification**: A button labeled "Relaunch to update" with a vertical ellipsis (three dots) for additional options.

### Navigation Controls

- **Navigation Buttons**: Located to the left of the address bar.
  - **Back Button**: Left-pointing arrow.
  - **Forward Button**: Right-pointing arrow.
  - **Reload Button**: Circular arrow icon.

## Main Content Area

### Google Search Interface

- **Google Logo**: Centered prominently on the page, displaying the multicolored "Google" text.
- **Search Bar**: A rounded rectangular input field below the logo.
  - **Placeholder Text**: "Search Google or type a URL".
  - **Search Icon**: A magnifying glass icon on the left side of the bar.
  - **Voice Search Icon**: A microphone icon on the right side.
  - **Google Lens Icon**: A camera icon with a colorful lens design on the far right.

### Quick Access Buttons

- **Web Store Button**: A circular icon with a rainbow-colored "W" symbol, labeled "Web Store" below it.
- **Add Shortcut Button**: A circular icon with a plus sign, labeled "Add shortcut" below it.

## Sidebar and System Tray

### Left Sidebar (Application Launcher)

- **Application Icons**: A vertical column of application icons on the left side of the screen.
  - **Google Chrome**: Topmost icon, currently active.
  - **Thunderbird Email Client**: Blue bird icon.
  - **Visual Studio Code**: Blue "VS Code" icon.
  - **VLC Media Player**: Orange traffic cone icon.
  - **LibreOffice Writer**: Blue document icon.
  - **LibreOffice Calc**: Green spreadsheet icon.
  - **LibreOffice Impress**: Orange presentation icon.
  - **GIMP Image Editor**: Gray wolf icon.
  - **File Manager**: Gray folder icon.
  - **Software Center**: Orange shopping bag icon.
  - **Help Application**: Blue question mark icon.
  - **Terminal**: Black terminal window icon.
  - **Recycle Bin**: Green recycling bin icon.
  - **Application Grid**: A 3x3 grid icon at the bottom for accessing all applications.

### Right Sidebar (Browser Controls)

- **Google Services Links**: Located in the top-right corner of the browser window.
  - **Gmail**: Text link for accessing Gmail.
  - **Images**: Text link for accessing Google Images.
  - **App Launcher**: A 3x3 grid icon for accessing Google apps.

## Bottom Right Corner

- **Customize Chrome Button**: A small button with a pencil icon and the text "Customise Chrome" for personalizing browser settings and appearance.
